G3100.strongs: intransitively, to become a pupil; transitively, to disciple, i.e. enrol as scholar
senses: intrans. (as prop. vb. in -εύω, and so Plut., mor. 837 with and elsew.), to be a disciple: with dative, [[r:MAT.27.57|Mat 27:57]] (Rec., WH, mg.).

Trans., to make a disciple: with accusative, [[r:MAT.28.19|Mat 28:19]], [[r:ACT.14.21|Act 14:21]]; pass., before dative, τ. Ἰησοῦ, [[r:MAT.27.57|Mat 27:57]] (WH, R); τ. βασιλείᾳ, [[r:MAT.13.52|Mat 13:52.]]† (AS)

a disciple: opposite to διδάσκαλος, [[r:MAT.10.24|Mat 10:24]], [[r:LUK.6.40|Luk 6:40]]; Ἰωάννου, [[r:MAT.9.14|Mat 9:14]], [[r:LUK.7.18|Luk 7:18]], [[r:JHN.3.25|Jhn 3:25]]; τ. Φαρισσίων, [[r:MAT.22.16|Mat 22:16]], [[r:MRK.2.18|Mrk 2:18]], [[r:LUK.5.33|Luk 5:33]]; Μωυσέως, [[r:JHN.9.28|Jhn 9:28]]; Ἰησοῦ, [[r:LUK.6.17|Luk 6:17 7:11 19:37]], [[r:JHN.6.66|Jhn 6:66 7:3 19:38]]; esp. the twelve, [[r:MAT.10.1|Mat 10:1 11:1]], [[r:MRK.7.17|Mrk 7:17]], [[r:LUK.8.9|Luk 8:9]], [[r:JHN.2.2|Jo 2:2]], al.; later, of Christians generally, [[r:ACT.6.1|Act 6:1, 2 7 9:19]], al.; τ. κυρίου, [[r:ACT.9.1|Act 9:1.]] (AS)
(= μαθητρίς, fem, of μαθητής, which see) a female disciple: [[r:ACT.9.36|Act 9:36.]]† (AS)

G3105.root: middle voice from a primary μάω (to long for
G3105.strongs: through the idea of insensate craving); to rave as a "maniac"

G3106.strongs: to beatify, i.e. pronounce (or esteem) fortunate
senses: μακαρζω (μακάριος), to bless, pronounce blessed or happy: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.1.48|Luk 1:48]], [[r:JAS.5.11|Jas 5:11]].† (AS)

G3107.root: a prolonged form of the poetical μάκαρ (meaning the same)
G3107.strongs: supremely blest; by extension, fortunate, well off
senses: (collat. form of poët. μάκαρ, in Hom., Hes., chiefly of the gods and the departed), blessed, happy (DCG, i, 177, 213): θεός (δυνάστης), [[r:1TI.1.11|1Ti 1:11 6:15]]; ἐλπίς, [[r:TIT.2.13|Tit 2:13]]; esp. in congratulations, usually with the omission of the copula (M, Pr., 180; B1., § 30, 3), μ. ὁ, [[r:MAT.5.3|Mat 5:3]] ff., [[r:LUK.6.20|Luk 6:20]] ff. [[r:JHN.20.29|Jhn 20:29]], [[r:REV.1.3|Rev 1:3]], al.; before ptcp., [[r:LUK.1.45|Luk 1:45]], al.; ὅς, [[r:MAT.11.6|Mat 11:6]], [[r:LUK.7.23|Luk 7:23]], [[r:ROM.4.7|Rom 4:7-8]]; ὅτι, [[r:MAT.13.16|Mat 13:16]], al.; ἐάν, [[r:JHN.13.17|Jhn 13:17]], [[r:1CO.7.40|1Co 7:40]]; compar., μ.... μᾶλλον, [[r:ACT.20.35|Act 20:35]]; -ώτερος, [[r:1CO.7.40|1Co 7:40]] SYN.: εὐλογητός, q.v (AS)

G3108.strongs: beatification, i.e. attribution of good fortune

G3110.strongs: a Macedon (Macedonian), i.e. inhabitant of Macedonia

G3111.strongs: a butcher's stall, meat market or provision-shop

G3112.root: feminine accusative case singular of [[w:G3117]] ([[w:G3598]] being implied)
senses: μακράν (prop. fem. accusative of μακρός, Sc. ὁδόν), adv., a long way, far: [[r:LUK.15.20|Luk 15:20]], [[r:ACT.22.21|Act 22:21]]; before ἀπό, [[r:MAT.8.30|Mat 8:30]], [[r:LUK.7.6|Luk 7:6]], [[r:JHN.21.8|Jhn 21:8]], [[r:ACT.17.27|Act 17:27]]; id. metaphorically, [[r:MRK.12.34|Mrk 12:34]]; οἱ εἰς μ., [[r:ACT.2.39|Act 2:39]] (cf. [[r:ISA.2.2|Isa 2:2]]); metaphorically, οἱ ποτὲ ὄντες μ. (opposite to ἐγγύς), [[r:EPH.2.13|Eph 2:13]]; οἱ μ., [[r:EPH.2.17|Eph 2:17.]]† (AS)

G3114.strongs: to be long-spirited, i.e. (objectively) forbearing or (subjectively) patient
G3114.kjv: bear (suffer) long, be longsuffering, have (long) patience, be patient, patiently endure
senses: Passively, to be patient, long-suffering: absol., [[r:1CO.13.4|1Co 13:4]], [[r:HEB.6.15|Heb 6:15]], [[r:JAS.5.8|Jas 5:8]]; before ἕως, with genitive, [[r:JAS.5.7|Jas 5:7]]; ἐπί, with dative, ib. ([[r:SIR.2.4|Sir 2:4]]); πρός, with accusative, [[r:1TH.5.14|1Th 5:14]]; ἐπί, with dative, [[r:MAT.18.26|Mat 18:26, 29]], [[r:LUK.18.7|Luk 18:7]]; εἰς, [[r:2PE.3.9|2Pe 3:9.]]† SYN.: ὑπομένω, q.v (AS)

(μακρό-θυμος),, patience, longsuffering: of men, esp. in experiencing troubles and difficulties, [[r:COL.1.11|Col 1:11]], [[r:2TI.3.10|2Ti 3:10]], [[r:HEB.6.12|Heb 6:12]], [[r:JAS.5.10|Jas 5:10]]; of God's forbearance, [[r:ROM.2.4|Rom 2:4 9:22]], [[r:2CO.6.6|2Co 6:6]], [[r:GAL.5.22|Gal 5:22]], [[r:EPH.4.2|Eph 4:2]], [[r:COL.3.12|Col 3:12]], [[r:1TI.1.16|1Ti 1:16]], [[r:2TI.4.2|2Ti 4:2]], [[r:1PE.3.20|1Pe 3:20]], [[r:2PE.3.15|2Pe 3:15]].† SYN.: ὑπομονή (cf. Lft., Col., 138; Tr., Syn., liii) (AS)

G3116.root: adverb of a compound of [[w:G3117]] and [[w:G2372]]

senses: of space and time, long: μακρὰ προσεύχεσθαι, [[r:MRK.12.40|Mrk 12:40]], [[r:LUK.20.47|Luk 20:47]]. of distance, far, far distant: χώρα, [[r:LUK.15.13|Luk 15:13 19:12]].† (AS)
In NT, as in LXX, = ἀσθένεια, weakness, sickness: νόσος καὶ μ., [[r:MAT.4.23|Mat 4:23 9:35 10:1]].† SYN.: see: ἀσθένεια (AS)

G3120.strongs: soft, i.e. fine (clothing); figuratively, a catamite
senses: prop., to the touch (opposite to σκληρός): of clothing, pl., [[r:MAT.11.8|Mat 11:8]], [[r:LUK.7.25|Luk 7:25]].
Of persons and their mode of living;
soft, effeminate: [[r:1CO.6.9|1Co 6:9]] (prob. in obscene sense, cf. Deiss., LAE, 150, 4; MM, xvi; Zorell, see word).† (AS)

G3122.root: neuter plural of the superlative of an apparently primary adverb μάλα (very)
G3122.strongs: (adverbially) most (in the greatest degree) or particularly
senses: Pos., very, very much, exceedingly (cl.; LXX ut supr.; in NT its place is taken by λίαν, σφόδρα, etc.).

Of increase, more; with qualifying words: πολλῷ, [[r:MRK.10.48|Mrk 10:48]], [[r:LUK.18.39|Luk 18:39]], [[r:ROM.5.15|Rom 5:15, 17]], [[r:PHP.2.12|Php 2:12]], al.; πόσῳ, [[r:LUK.12.24|Luk 12:24]], [[r:ROM.11.12|Rom 11:12]], al.; τοσούτῳ... ὅσῳ, [[r:HEB.10.25|Heb 10:25.]]

Of comparison, the more: [[r:LUK.5.15|Luk 5:15]], [[r:JHN.5.18|Jhn 5:18]], [[r:ACT.5.14|Act 5:14]], [[r:1TH.4.1|1Th 4:1, 10]], [[r:2PE.1.10|2Pe 1:10]]; ἔτι μ. καὶ μ., [[r:PHP.1.9|Php 1:9]]; with compar., [[r:MRK.7.36|Mrk 7:36]], [[r:2CO.7.13|2Co 7:13]]; πολλῴ μ. κρεῖσον, [[r:PHP.1.23|Php 1:23]]; μ. διαφέρειν, with genitive, [[r:MAT.6.26|Mat 6:26]]; μ. ἤ, [[r:MAT.18.13|Mat 18:13]]; with genitive, [[r:1CO.14.18|1Co 14:18]]; as periphr. for compar., [[r:ACT.20.35|Act 20:35]], [[r:1CO.9.15|1Co 9:15]], [[r:GAL.4.27|Gal 4:27]]; μ. δέ (EV, yea rather), [[r:ROM.8.34|Rom 8:34.]]

Of preference, rather, the rather, sooner: with qualifying words, πολλῷ, [[r:MAT.6.30|Mat 6:30]], al.; πολύ, [[r:HEB.12.25|Heb 12:25]]; πόσῳ, [[r:MAT.7.11|Mat 7:11]], al.; in a question, οὐ μ., [[r:1CO.9.12|1Co 9:12]]; after a neg., [[r:MAT.10.6|Mat 10:6]], al.; θέλω (εὐδοκῶ) μ., [[r:1CO.14.5|1Co 14:5]], [[r:2CO.5.8|2Co 5:8]]; ζηλῶ, [[r:1CO.14.1|1Co 14:1]]; with subst., τ. σκότος ἢ τ. φῶς, [[r:JHN.3.19|Jhn 3:19]]; μ. δέ, [[r:GAL.4.9|Gal 4:9.]]

G3123.root: neuter of the comparative of the same as [[w:G3122]]
G3123.strongs: (adverbially) more (in a greater degree)) or rather
G3123.kjv: + better, X far, (the) more (and more), (so) much (the more), rather
senses: Pos., very, very much, exceedingly (cl.; LXX ut supr.; in NT its place is taken by λίαν, σφόδρα, etc.).

Of increase, more; with qualifying words: πολλῷ, [[r:MRK.10.48|Mrk 10:48]], [[r:LUK.18.39|Luk 18:39]], [[r:ROM.5.15|Rom 5:15, 17]], [[r:PHP.2.12|Php 2:12]], al.; πόσῳ, [[r:LUK.12.24|Luk 12:24]], [[r:ROM.11.12|Rom 11:12]], al.; τοσούτῳ... ὅσῳ, [[r:HEB.10.25|Heb 10:25.]]

Of comparison, the more: [[r:LUK.5.15|Luk 5:15]], [[r:JHN.5.18|Jhn 5:18]], [[r:ACT.5.14|Act 5:14]], [[r:1TH.4.1|1Th 4:1, 10]], [[r:2PE.1.10|2Pe 1:10]]; ἔτι μ. καὶ μ., [[r:PHP.1.9|Php 1:9]]; with compar., [[r:MRK.7.36|Mrk 7:36]], [[r:2CO.7.13|2Co 7:13]]; πολλῴ μ. κρεῖσον, [[r:PHP.1.23|Php 1:23]]; μ. διαφέρειν, with genitive, [[r:MAT.6.26|Mat 6:26]]; μ. ἤ, [[r:MAT.18.13|Mat 18:13]]; with genitive, [[r:1CO.14.18|1Co 14:18]]; as periphr. for compar., [[r:ACT.20.35|Act 20:35]], [[r:1CO.9.15|1Co 9:15]], [[r:GAL.4.27|Gal 4:27]]; μ. δέ (EV, yea rather), [[r:ROM.8.34|Rom 8:34.]]

Of preference, rather, the rather, sooner: with qualifying words, πολλῷ, [[r:MAT.6.30|Mat 6:30]], al.; πολύ, [[r:HEB.12.25|Heb 12:25]]; πόσῳ, [[r:MAT.7.11|Mat 7:11]], al.; in a question, οὐ μ., [[r:1CO.9.12|1Co 9:12]]; after a neg., [[r:MAT.10.6|Mat 10:6]], al.; θέλω (εὐδοκῶ) μ., [[r:1CO.14.5|1Co 14:5]], [[r:2CO.5.8|2Co 5:8]]; ζηλῶ, [[r:1CO.14.1|1Co 14:1]]; with subst., τ. σκότος ἢ τ. φῶς, [[r:JHN.3.19|Jhn 3:19]]; μ. δέ, [[r:GAL.4.9|Gal 4:9.]]

G3124.forms: Μάλχος, -ου, ὁ (Hellenistic form of Heb. מֶלֶךְ)

senses: in cl., a child's name for mother.
In late Gk. (= cl., τήθη), a grandmother: (LXX, l.with), [[r:2TI.1.5|2Ti 1:5.]]† (AS)

G3126.root: of Chaldee origin (confidence, i.e. wealth, personified)

G3129.root: prolongation from a primary verb, another form of which, μαθέω, is used as an alternate in certain tenses
senses: to learn, esp. by inquiry: absol., [[r:1CO.14.31|1Co 14:31]], [[r:1TI.2.11|1Ti 2:11]], [[r:2TI.3.7|2Ti 3:7]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:JHN.7.15|Jhn 7:15]] (sc. αὐτά), [[r:ROM.16.17|Rom 16:17]], [[r:1CO.14.35|1Co 14:35]], [[r:PHP.4.9|Php 4:9]], [[r:2TI.3.14|2Ti 3:14]], [[r:REV.14.3|Rev 14:3]]; before quaes. indir., [[r:MAT.9.13|Mat 9:13]]; Χριστόν, [[r:EPH.4.20|Eph 4:20]] (ICC, in l); before ἀπό, with genitive of thing(s), [[r:MAT.24.32|Mat 24:32]], [[r:MRK.13.28|Mrk 13:28]]; ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.11.29|Mat 11:29]], [[r:COL.1.7|Col 1:7]]; παρά, with genitive of person(s), [[r:2TI.3.14|2Ti 3:14]]; ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[r:1CO.4.6|1Co 4:6]]; "point" aorist (M, Pr., 117), to ascertain, before ὅτι, [[r:ACT.23.27|Act 23:27]]; with accusative before ἀπό, [[r:GAL.3.2|Gal 3:2.]]

to learn by use and practice, acquire the habit of, be accustomed to: with inf. (Bl., § 69, 4), [[r:1TI.5.4|1Ti 5:4]], [[r:TIT.3.14|Tit 3:14]]; id. with nom, in pred. (El., § 72, 1), [[r:PHP.4.11|Php 4:11]]; with accusative of thing(s) before ἀπό, [[r:HEB.5.8|Heb 5:8]]; ἀργαὶ μανθάνουσιν (EV, they learn to be idle; Bl., § 73, 5; Field, Notes, 210), [[r:1TI.5.13|1Ti 5:13.]]† (AS)

G3132.root: from a derivative of [[w:G3105]] (meaning a prophet, as supposed to rave through inspiration)
G3132.strongs: to divine, i.e. utter spells (under pretense of foretelling
senses: (μαντίς, a seer, diviner), to divine, practise divination: [[r:ACT.16.16|Act 16:16.]]† SYN.: προφητεύω, which see, in distinction from which μ. is used in LXX and NT only of false prophets and those who practise the heathen arts of divination and soothsaying (cf. [[r:1SA.28.8|1Ki 28:8]], and see Tr., Syn., § vi) (AS)

G3133.strongs: to extinguish (as fire), i.e. (figuratively and passively) to pass away
senses: prop., to quench fire; pass., of fire, to die away, go out.

In various relations, to quench, waste, wear out (cf. [[r:WIS.19.21|Wis 19:21]]); pass., to waste away; in later writers (Plut., Luc., al.), of the withering of flowers and herbage (act., [[r:JOB.15.30|Job 15:30]]; pass., [[r:JOB.24.24|Job 24:24]], [[r:WIS.2.8|Wis 2:8]]): [[r:JAS.1.11|Jas 1:11]] (cf. ἀμάραντον).† (AS)

G3134.forms: μαρὰν ἀθά (Rec. μαραναθά; Aram.: on the original form see Dalman, Gr., § 41, 1; 74, 3; Words, 328)
G3134.root: of Chaldee origin (meaning our Lord has come)
G3134.strongs: maranatha, i.e. an exclamation of the approaching divine judgment
senses: Maranatha, i.e. the Lord cometh (but see Dalman, ll. with; Field, Notes, 180; ICC, in l): [[r:1CO.16.22|1Co 16:22.]]† (AS)

G3137.forms: Μαρία, -ας (Hellenized form), and Μαριάμ, indecl., ἡ (Aram. מַרְיָם; Heb. מִרְיָם)
G3137.strongs: Maria or Mariam (i.e. Mirjam), the name of six Christian females
senses: The wife of Clopas ([[r:JHN.19.25|Jhn 19:25]]) and mother of James the little, and Joses: [[r:MAT.27.56|Mat 27:56, 61 28:1]], [[r:MRK.15.40|Mrk 15:40, 47 16:1]], [[r:LUK.24.10|Luk 24:10]].
The sister of Martha and Lazarus: [[r:LUK.10.39|Luk 10:39, 42]] [[r:JHN.11.1|Jhn 11:1-2, 19]] ff. [[r:JHN.12.3|Jhn 12:3]].
A Christian greeted by St. Paul: [[r:ROM.16.6|Rom 16:6]] (on the signification of the name, see Zorell, see word; on the use of the alternative forms in NT, DB, iii, 278 bn).† (AS)

G3140.strongs: to be a witness, i.e. testify (literally or figuratively)
G3140.kjv: charge, give (evidence), bear record, have (obtain, of) good (honest) report, be well reported of, testify, give (have) testimony, (be, bear, give, obtain) witness
senses: prop., to be a witness, bear witness, testify: absol. (find., al.), [[r:JHN.15.27|Jhn 15:27]], [[r:ACT.26.5|Act 26:5]]; parenthetical (Bl., § 79, 7; MM, xvi), [[r:2CO.8.3|2Co 8:3]]; with dative of person(s) (comm. and incomm.; El., § 37, 2), [[r:ACT.22.5|Act 22:5]], [[r:HEB.10.15|Heb 10:15]]; id. before ὅτι, [[r:MAT.23.31|Mat 23:31]], [[r:ROM.10.2|Rom 10:2]], al.; accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.10.43|Act 10:43]]; with accusative of thing(s) (cl.), [[r:JHN.3.11|Jhn 3:11]], [[r:REV.22.16|Rev 22:16, 20]]; with accusative cogn., before περί, [[r:JHN.5.32|Jhn 5:32]], [[r:1JN.5.10|1Jn 5:10]]; with dative of thing(s), [[r:JHN.5.33|Jhn 5:33]], [[r:ACT.14.3|Act 14:3]], al.; before περί, with genitive (of person(s) and of thing(s)), [[r:JHN.1.7|Jhn 1:7-8, 15 2:25 18:23 21:24]], al.; id. before ὅτι, [[r:JHN.5.36|Jhn 5:36 7:7]]; ὅτι, [[r:JHN.1.34|Jhn 1:34 4:44]] al.; ὅτι recit., [[r:JHN.4.39|Jhn 4:39]]; κατά before ὅτι, [[r:1CO.15.15|1Co 15:15]]; pass., [[r:HEB.7.8|Heb 7:8]]; ptcp., [[r:ROM.3.21|Rom 3:21]]; impers., [[r:HEB.7.17|Heb 7:17]];

in late Gk., to witness favourably, give a good report, approve (Bl., § 54, 3; MM, xvi; Deiss., BS, 265): with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.4.22|Luk 4:22]]; before ἐπί with dative of thing(s), [[r:HEB.11.4|Heb 11:4]]; pass., [[r:ACT.6.3|Act 6:3]]; before ἐν, [[r:1TI.5.10|1Ti 5:10]], [[r:HEB.11.2|Heb 11:2]]; διά, with genitive of thing(s), [[r:HEB.11.39|Heb 11:39]]; with genitive of person(s), [[r:ACT.10.22|Act 10:22]], al.; impers., III Jn 12 (cf. ἐπι, συν-επι-, κατα-, συν-μαρτυρέω) (AS)

(μαρτυρέω), witness, testimony, evidence: [[r:MRK.14.56|Mrk 14:56]], [[r:LUK.22.71|Luk 22:71]], [[r:JHN.5.34|Jhn 5:34 19:35 21:24]], [[r:1TI.3.7|1Ti 3:7]], [[r:TIT.1.13|Tit 1:13]], 3Jn 12, [[r:REV.11.7|Rev 11:7]]; with genitive subj., [[r:MRK.14.59|Mrk 14:59]], [[r:JHN.8.17|Jhn 8:17]] (LXX aliter), [[r:1JN.5.9|1Jn 5:9]]; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), [[r:MRK.14.55|Mrk 14:55]]; esp. of witness concerning Christ and divine things, [[r:JHN.1.7|Jhn 1:7 3:11, 32-33 5:32, 36]] [[r:REV.6.9|Rev 6:9]]; with genitive subj., [[r:JHN.1.19|Jhn 1:19 5:31 8:13-14]], [[r:ACT.22.18|Act 22:18]], [[r:1JN.5.9|1Jn 5:9-11]], [[r:REV.12.11|Rev 12:11]]; with genitive obj., [[r:REV.1.2|Rev 1:2, 9 12:17 19:10 20:4]]; μ. ἔχειν, [[r:REV.6.9|Rev 6:9 12:17 19:10]].† (AS)

G3142.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of [[w:G3144]]
G3142.strongs: something evidential, i.e. (genitive case) evidence given or (specially), the Decalogue (in the sacred Tabernacle)
senses: (μάρτυρ) a testimony, witness, proof (Hdt., Thuc., al.): with genitive subj., [[r:2CO.1.12|2Co 1:12]], [[r:2TH.1.10|2Th 1:10]]; with genitive obj., [[r:ACT.4.33|Act 4:33]], [[r:1CO.1.6|1Co 1:6 2:1]] (WH, txt., R, txt., μυστήριον; [[r:2TI.1.8|2Ti 1:8]]; εἰς μ., [[r:MAT.8.4|Mat 8:4 10:18]] [[r:MAT.24.14|Mat 24:14]], [[r:MRK.1.44|Mrk 1:44 6:11 13:9]], [[r:LUK.5.14|Luk 5:14 9:5 21:13]], [[r:HEB.3.5|Heb 3:5]], [[r:JAS.5.3|Jas 5:3]]; τὸ μ. καιροῖς ἰδίοις (CGT, in l), [[r:1TI.2.6|1Ti 2:6]]; ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μ. (LXX for מוֹעֵד אֹהֶל), [[r:ACT.7.44|Act 7:44]], [[r:REV.15.5|Rev 15:5]].† (AS)

G3143.strongs: to be adduced as a witness, i.e. (figuratively) to obtest (in affirmation or exhortation)
senses: (μάρτυρ), to summon as witness (M, Th., 25 f.; Hort., 1Pe., 53 f.; Lft., Notes, 29; Ga 203), hence,
to adjure, beseech: with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.26.22|Act 26:22]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:EPH.4.17|Eph 4:17]]; before εἰς, [[r:1TH.2.12|1Th 2:12]] (cf. δια-, προ-μαρτύρομαι).† (AS)

G3144.strongs: a witness (literally (judicially) or figuratively (genitive case)); by analogy, a "martyr"
senses: (Æolic μάρτυρ), -υρος, ὁ (also ἡ), a witness: [[r:ACT.10.41|Act 10:41]], [[r:1TI.6.12|1Ti 6:12]], [[r:2TI.2.2|2Ti 2:2]], [[r:HEB.12.1|Heb 12:1]] (Westc., in l); in forensic sense, [[r:MAT.18.16|Mat 18:16 26:65]], [[r:MRK.14.63|Mrk 14:63]], [[r:ACT.6.13|Act 6:13 7:58]], [[r:2CO.13.1|2Co 13:1]], [[r:1TI.5.19|1Ti 5:19]], [[r:HEB.10.28|Heb 10:28]]; with genitive obj., [[r:LUK.24.48|Luk 24:48]], [[r:ACT.1.22|Act 1:22 2:32 3:15 5:32 10:39 26:16]], [[r:1PE.5.1|1Pe 5:1]]; with genitive poss., [[r:ACT.1.8|Act 1:8 13:31]], [[r:REV.11.3|Rev 11:3]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.11.48|Luk 11:48]], [[r:ACT.22.15|Act 22:15]]; of Christ, [[r:REV.1.5|Rev 1:5 3:14]]; of God, [[r:ROM.1.9|Rom 1:9]], [[r:2CO.1.23|2Co 1:23]], [[r:PHP.1.8|Php 1:8]], [[r:1TH.2.5|1Th 2:5 2:10]]; of those who have witnessed for Christ by their death (in later Xn. lit., martyr: Swete, Ap., 35), [[r:ACT.22.20|Act 22:20]], [[r:REV.2.13|Rev 2:13 17:6]].† (AS)

G3145.root: from a primary μάσσω (to handle or squeeze)
senses: μασάομαι (Rec. μασσ), -ῶμαι (Aristoph. and late writers, but not in Trag. or in good Att.. prose), to bite, chew: [[r:REV.16.10|Rev 16:10.]]† (AS)
